description: Retrieve Public Assistance (PA) funded project records for a disaster or state — shows where federal recovery money was obligated. Returns applicant, damage category, project size and status, federal share obligated, and total obligated amounts. Either disaster_number or state must be provided. Use disaster_number (from fema_search_disasters) to scope to a single declaration, or state to browse all PA projects for a state. PA projects are created only when the PA program is declared (pa_declared: true on the disaster).

disaster_number.description: FEMA disaster number to scope results to a single declaration. Numbers above 32767 match no declaration.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return (1–1000, default 100).

state.description: Two-letter state code to browse all PA projects for a state.

name: fema_get_public_assistance

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_state`: The state parameter is not a valid 2-letter US state/territory code. `missing_filter`: Neither disaster_number nor state was provided. `not_found`: The disaster number is above 32767, the highest number OpenFEMA holds, so no declaration exists. `no_results`: No PA project records found for the given filters. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Paging guidance when offset is at or past the end of the matching projects — names the total and the last valid offset.

items.description: A single Public Assistance funded project record.

applicant_id.description: FEMA applicant identifier for the recipient organization. Absent when not recorded.

application_title.description: Name of the applicant organization or project. Absent when not recorded.

county.description: County where the project is located. Absent when not recorded.

damage_category_code.description: FEMA damage category code (e.g., A=Debris Removal, B=Emergency Protective Measures, C=Roads and Bridges). Absent when unclassified.

damage_category_description.description: Human-readable name for the damage category code. Absent when unclassified.

disaster_number.description: FEMA disaster number this project belongs to.

federal_share_obligated.description: Federal dollars obligated for this project in USD; 0 when nothing is obligated.

first_obligation_date.description: ISO 8601 date the first federal obligation was recorded. Absent before obligation.

project_amount.description: Total estimated project cost in USD. Absent when not yet determined.

project_size.description: Project size classification: "small" (≤$1M) or "large" (>$1M). Absent when unclassified.

project_status.description: Current project status (e.g., Obligated, Closed, In Progress). Absent when not set.

pw_number.description: Project Worksheet number assigned by FEMA. Absent when not yet assigned.

state.description: Two-letter state abbreviation. Absent when not recorded.

total_obligated.description: Total obligated amount across all funding sources in USD; 0 when nothing is obligated.

returned_count.description: Number of projects in this response.

totalCount.description: Total matching projects before pagination — exceeds returned_count when results were capped at the limit.

title: Get FEMA Public Assistance Projects
